::: {.callout-note .se-question appearance="simple"}
## The question

[It's possible to remove the internal shading from a beamer rounded box?](https://tex.stackexchange.com/questions/5582/its-possible-to-remove-the-internal-shading-from-a-beamer-rounded-box), asked by ricky13 on TeX Stack Exchange (2010-11-18; [CC BY-SA 2.5](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.5/)):

> I'm trying to modify a `Beamer` template in order to have at the same time:
>
> 1) rounded boxes
> 2) shadows around the box
> 3) a defined line (without shading) between block title and block body (as in innertheme default)
>
> First two points are easy (`\useinnertheme[shadow=true]{rounded}`), does anybody know how to solve the third problem?
>
> Thanks
:::

Try this:

```latex
\addtobeamertemplate{block begin}{}{%
   {\usebeamercolor[fg]{block title}{\rule{\textwidth}{0.4pt}}}
}
```
